title: Delete the merged remote branches
description:
## Decision already made
Ryan approved (2026-10-17, this thread): delete all remote branches that are fully merged into main.

## Why it is an issue and not done
`git push origin --delete` from the cloud sandbox returns HTTP 403 from the git proxy, so the deletion must be run from somewhere with delete permission (the GitHub UI "Branches" page, or a local clone).

## Branches to delete (every tip is an ancestor of origin/main as of main at ece28f4)
claude/project-thread-6xq9b7, cursor/reference-anchor-1503, feat/pipeline-metadata-field, feature/blbs-465066-lxml-advisory, feature/blbs-6415ba-funsd-zip-slip-fix, feature/blbs-7e43f4-kanbus-artifacts, feature/blbs-7e43f4-snyk-deps, feature/blbs-9459a5-dashboard-audit-remediation, feature/blbs-c97601-litellm-advisory, feature/configurable-exemplar-count-and-recency-sort, feature/dependabot-mako-ujson-remediation, feature/poetry-conversion, feature/pypdf-snyk-remediation-from-develop, feature/release-bot, feature/ruleset-iac, feature/snyk-funsd-archive-extraction-remediation, feature/snyk-parent-remediation-gitpython-urllib3-idna, fix/codeql-cyclic-imports, fix/codeql-findings, fix/dependabot-findings, fix/semantic-release-build-command, fix/snyk-findings

Re-check before deleting: `git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/<branch> origin/main` must succeed for each. Do not delete `main`.

## Keep
All branches with unmerged commits, including `claude/project-thread-dmru5y*`, `codex/*`, `cursor/grobid-spacy-dedup-1503`, `develop`, `dev`, and the older feature branches (see the triage task).
